features.name: Engine
features.description: Improve agents autonomously. Surface and diagnose undetected issues autonomously to improve agents faster. LangSmith Engine clusters production failures into prioritized issues, finds the root cause in your traces and code, and proposes the fix for your review.

features.name: Observability
features.description: See exactly what your agents are doing. Understand exactly what your agent is doing: native tracing for popular agent frameworks and OpenTelemetry, SDKs for multiple languages, message threading for multi‑turn chat interactions, and analytics with AI‑driven insights to uncover patterns across traces.

features.name: Evaluation
features.description: Score and improve agent performance. Use real‑world usage for iterative improvement: capture production traces, turn them into test cases, and score agents with a mix of human review and automated evaluations. Includes reusable LLM‑as‑judge and multi‑turn evals, eval calibration with human feedback, human feedback annotations, and online/offline scoring.

features.name: Deployment
features.description: Ship and scale agents in production. Supports human‑in‑the‑loop interactions, input concurrency, and background agents; type‑safe streaming of messages, UI components, and custom events; scalable, distributed runtime to handle agent swarms; native protocol support for A2A & MCP.

features.name: Fleet
features.description: Agents for the whole company. Bring your own models, use first‑party integrations or extend with any MCP server, export agent files for pro‑code development, integrated LangSmith tracing, and agents improve with user feedback.

features.name: deepagents
features.description: Build long‑running agents for complex tasks, offering intelligent, open‑ended capabilities for highly autonomous agents.

features.name: langchain
features.description: Quick start agents with any model provider, enabling fast development with templates.

features.name: langgraph
features.description: Build reliable agents with low‑level control, suitable for production agents that require determinism.

features.name: Build with our open source frameworks
features.description: Build agents fast with any model provider. Choose the right framework for the job from batteries included to low-level control.
